reviews.title: Great addition to any PC build
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/E1vxNSS-DXL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/91aoOib9PzL._SY256.jpg The Lian Li 8.8" display has been one of the most satisfying additions to my setup.  The first thing that stands out is the versatility of the mounting system.  You get multiple options with the included mount, which makes it incredibly easy to place the screen exactly where it fits your build’s aesthetics and layout.  Whether you want it on the outside of the case, behind the glass, mounted to a fan (how I mounted), or tucked into a custom spot, the flexibility is there.
Installation is surprisingly simple.  Lian Li clearly put thought into the hardware design, and it shows as everything feels solid, well‑made, and premium. The build quality is excellent, and the screen itself looks fantastic, with sharp visuals and great brightness for both system stats and custom loops, etc.
The only real learning curve is the software.  L‑Connect 3 works well, but it takes a little time to get used to the layout and customization options.  Once you get the hang of it, though, the possibilities open up fast.
Overall, this display is a great way to personalize your build while also giving you useful real‑time system data.  If you enjoy both aesthetics and functionality, this little screen delivers on both fronts.
reviews.author: Aaron

reviews.title: High Quality Screen – Looks Amazing in My Case
reviews.comment:
I’ve been using the Lian Li Universal LCD screen for about a day now and I’m honestly really impressed. The first thing that stood out to me was the size — it’s bigger than I expected, and it actually fills the space in my case really nicely. The display is bright, clear, and makes the whole build look a lot more premium.
Another thing I noticed right away is how solid it feels. The screen and housing feel sturdy and well built, not cheap or flimsy at all. Once it’s installed it stays in place well and feels stable, which is important for something mounted inside a PC. It definitely seems like it’s made to last.
Setup was simple and once it was running it instantly made my PC feel more customized. Being able to display visuals or system info adds a really cool touch to the setup.
Overall I’m really happy with it so far. Great screen quality, solid build, and it looks amazing inside the case. Definitely worth it if you want to add something unique to your PC build!
reviews.author: Francisco Garcia

reviews.title: Great Software/Great Screen
reviews.comment:
I was a little hesitant because the reviews on this screen are pretty mixed, but after installing it myself, I’m genuinely glad I bought it.
Installation was very easy and straightforward, even compared to other internal or auxiliary PC screens I’ve tried. One of the biggest positives for me is that it uses USB only, so it doesn’t eat up an HDMI or DisplayPort connection on your GPU. That alone makes it far more practical than a lot of competing screens.
The software/app is solid, which is something I really appreciate. I’ve dealt with too many small PC screens that rely on sketchy, unfinished, or poorly translated software. This one feels polished and stable by comparison, and it just works without constant tweaking or crashes.
Image quality looks great for its size, and it does exactly what I wanted it to do as a system display. Overall, this feels like a well-designed product that’s gotten a bit of an unfair review. If you’re on the fence because of the reviews, I’d say it’s absolutely worth it.
reviews.author: Electryc03

reviews.title: Nice system monitor - EZ setup
reviews.comment: Super easy set up.  There are templates available that will work for you immediately once you install L-connect 3 software.  I wish there were more templates to choose from or a site to download some from, but I didnt find any on early searches.  You can create your own as well with the software, but it will take some practice.  The monitor looks great and seems pretty sturdy, metal case.  The little stand works fine if you use it or you can just mount it in your PC if you like as well.  Nice that you dont have to use a GPU slot, love that.  1920 x 480 looks nice and clear and color is also good.
